Horse_Description: Train them well and they will be great companions. Lives in the barn, ride from the stable.
HorseShoeCopper_Description: A rusted horseshoe made from copper. It might be worth reusing.
HorseShoeIron_Description: A strong horseshoe made from iron. It might be worth reusing.
HorseShoeGold_Description: A horseshoe made from gold. It might be worth reusing.
HorseManure_Description: Horse manure. Can be processed into fertilizer.
SaddleBrown_Description: A classic brown leather saddle and matching bridle.
SaddleWhite_Description: A clean white saddle and matching bridle.
SaddleBlack_Description: A sleek black saddle and matching bridle.
SaddleRed_Description: A bold red saddle and matching bridle.
SaddleOrange_Description: A vibrant orange saddle and matching bridle.
SaddleTeal_Description: A striking teal saddle and matching bridle.
SaddleGreen_Description: A deep forest-green saddle and matching bridle.
SaddleIce_Description: A frosty pale saddle and matching bridle.
SaddleLavender_Description: A soft lavender saddle and matching bridle.
SaddleRainbow_Description: A dazzling rainbow saddle and matching bridle.
SaddleTrans_Description: A saddle and bridal in the colors of the trans pride flag.
SaddleLesbian_Description: A saddle and bridal in the colors of the lesbian pride flag.
SaddleAce_Description: A saddle and bridal in the colors of the ace pride flag.
SaddleNonBinary_Description: A saddle and bridal in the colors of the non-binary pride flag.
SaddleBisexual_Description: A saddle and bridal in the colors of the bisexual pride flag.
IVPotionSpeed_Description: A shimmering blue potion. Give it to a horse to permanently improve its natural speed.
IVPotionSprint_Description: A fiery orange potion. Give it to a horse to permanently improve its natural sprint.
IVPotionJump_Description: A vibrant green potion. Give it to a horse to permanently improve its natural jumping ability.
TrainingPotion_Description: A swirling purple potion. Give it to a horse and today's training comes twice as easily: every stat needs only half the usual work.
GallopPotion_Description: A golden potion brewed for the rider, not the horse. Drink it and your own legs grow strong.
CoatPotion_Description: A swirling pink potion. Give it to a horse for a change of looks, and there's no telling which one you'll get.
HorseStatue_Description: A golden trophy awarded to the champion of the Spring Horse Festival.
FestivalSpectator_Dialog_0: Every year this race gets more exciting. I love seeing how the horses have grown!
FestivalSpectator_Dialog_2: I always look forward to this. There's nothing like watching the race on a day like today.
FestivalSpectator_Dialog_3: It's a great turnout this year! The horses look fantastic.
FestivalSpectator_Dialog_5: I always make sure to clear my schedule for this. Wouldn't want to miss the race!
